name: mywb-macos
description: Read and adjust the Western blot document open in MyWB.

interface.shortDescription: Read and adjust the Western blot document open in MyWB.
interface.longDescription:
Lets an assistant work in the MyWB window you have open: read the active
document, adjust the ROI, rename marker and sample labels, and run lane
quantification.

MyWB has to be running with `AI assistant access` switched on -- the AI button
beside `Copy SVG for PowerPoint`. It is a Premium feature and is off by
default. Nothing leaves this computer: MyWB listens on 127.0.0.1 only and every
request carries an access token regenerated each time it starts.

Every change an assistant makes lands as one step in the Edit menu, so Ctrl+Z
takes back one action at a time. Saving is never done for you.
defaultPrompt: What does MyWB have open right now?
Quantify the lanes in the current ROI.
Rename the sample labels to my treatment groups.
